SETTLED RULE, not to be reopened. Greg confirmed on 2026-11-15 (via Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #1790): „Tak miało być. Uzgodnione juz 100 razy + Kimi.”

Since commit 30ddf016 (2026-11-07), a test-launcher run's before/after input identity IS its recorded source_id equality: results.sourceIdBefore == results.sourceIdAfter, compared as a whole object (docs/test.md "Ordinary committed-input runs"). Drift before the run stops it, and drift after prevents a pass. The launcher computes NO input fingerprint any more. The review-freeze fingerprint lives only in explicit review-freeze commands, reviewer identities, test-ref names, commit messages and Review-Freeze trailers.

So any rule or check that says a run's "fingerprint before and after" means source_id equality. A remote FULL on a test ref gates a landing when its source_id before and after are equal, the test-ref name and commit bind the review-freeze fingerprint, and the integration owner records the run id, host, commit, tree and both source_ids. Authority text is being aligned in w-7b234e31e827. Do NOT raise this as a question again, and do not ask Greg about it.

Why it resurfaced: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md lagged behind docs/test.md after the cutover. Whenever docs/test.md changes run-identity semantics, check the authority text in the same change.
